_comment: Paste the mcpServers block into your MCP client's config and SearchRoute's
five tools appear with no code on your side.
Claude Code:    ~/.claude.json  (or run: claude mcp add)
Replace /path/to/python with the interpreter that has searchroute installed,
and set whichever provider keys you have. With no keys it still works via
DuckDuckGo plus local extraction, just less reliably.
SEARCHROUTE_PROFILE and SEARCHROUTE_MAX_RESULTS are the operator's cost
controls: the model never sees or sets them.
